description:
Required Skills:

5+ years of experience developing scalable and responsive enterprise applications using JS/Java applications
3+ years of experience using NodeJS framework
3+ years of experience with ExpressJS, Bootstrap, MySQL, and CSS3
Must have practical hands-on experience building RESTful APIs
Experience developing internal enterprise applications (building HR applications is a plus)
UNIX/Linux systems proficiency
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and have a solid background working in an Agile/Scrumenvironment
Excellent communication skills

Preferred:

Experience developing enterprise applications with Python is highly desired
Any experience using ServiceNow, Jelly Script, and AngularJS framework (for ServiceNow Custom UX Development)
Solid understanding of the importance of good design, as well as the importance of promptly fixing bugs
Working knowledge of Less/Stylus & JADE/EJS
Exposure with Play framework is a plus. 


 NodeJS framework,ExpressJS, Bootstrap, MySQL 


 Only GC/Citizen
